name: British Reinforcements (BR 2)
play_event_when: R-check passes for BR (London AP-controlled, supplied, room for an army). Play in the first AR with no emergency.
notes: Army + corps in one action, plus WS +1 toward AP Limited War. One BR reinforcement card per turn: play this or BR 1st Army first.

name: Blockade
play_event_when: Always legal. Play at the first AR without an emergency, ideally turn 1-2 and certainly before the first Winter turn (turn 4).
notes: -1 VP in every Winter War Status Phase (turns 4,8,12,16,20) after play: up to 5 VP. +2 WS. Prerequisite for Lusitania.

name: Russian Reinforcements (RU 11)
play_event_when: R-check passes for RU (Petrograd, Moscow, Kharkov or Caucasus AP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room). No two-army RU card playable instead this turn.
notes: Army + corps. Only one RU reinforcement card per turn, so play the two-army cards (RU 9/10, RU 6/7) first.

name: Pleve
play_event_when: In combat: a RU unit attacks or defends and the battle matters (an army at risk, a VP or fort space, or +1 likely changes the outcome).
hold_as_cc_when: RU units are adjacent to CP units; keep it unless it is the only card to play or its OPS are needed for a RU MO.
notes: Removed after use, so spend it on one important battle; +1 either attacking or defending.

name: Putnik
play_event_when: In combat, turns 1-7 only: a SB unit (MN does not count) attacks or defends.
hold_as_cc_when: Turn 7 or earlier and SB units adjacent to CP units. After turn 7 discard it at end of turn or use as OPS/SR/RP.
notes: Not removed; if the combat is won it stays face up and can help once per AR for the rest of the turn. Dead after turn 7 (Fall 1915).

name: Withdrawal
play_event_when: In combat while defending: a corps step loss is required and retreating one space gives up no VP space, fort or supply line.
hold_as_cc_when: AP units adjacent to strong CP stacks (2+ armies) that are likely to attack this turn.
notes: Removed after use. Negates one corps step (or an army step if no corps step) at the cost of a retreat; full-strength attackers may advance.

name: Severe Weather
play_event_when: In combat: CP attacks an AP-defended mountain space in Fall/Winter, or a swamp space in Spring/Fall (+2 to defender).
hold_as_cc_when: This turn or next is Fall/Winter and AP holds mountain spaces facing CP, or Spring/Fall and AP holds swamp spaces facing CP.
notes: Not removed. Seasons: Fall = turns 3,7,11,15,19; Winter = 4,8,12,16,20; Spring = 5,9,13,17. No season on turns 1-2.

name: Russian Reinforcements (2 corps)
play_event_when: Turn 2+, no RU reinforcement played this turn, and no RU army reinforcement card in hand that is playable this turn.
notes: Two corps go to the Reserve Box, so placement is always possible. Cheap 2-OP card, but it uses the turn's only RU reinforcement play.

name: Moltke
play_event_when: Turn 1 or 2 only. Play in the first AP action of turn 1 if possible.
notes: CP activation in Belgium/France costs 1 OP per unit until CP spends Falkenhayn; blunts the 1914 western drive. Dead after turn 2: OPS/SR only.

name: French Reinforcements (FR 10)
play_event_when: R-check passes for FR (Paris AP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged with room; Orleans allowed only if Paris is full).
notes: One army. One FR reinforcement card per turn.

name: Russian Reinforcements (RU 9, RU 10)
play_event_when: R-check passes for RU with room for TWO armies among Petrograd, Moscow, Kharkov and Caucasus.
notes: Two armies for a 3-OP card; the best early RU card. Play before other RU reinforcements.

name: Entrench
play_event_when: Turn 2+; no Entrench event played yet by either side; a supplied AP army is in a front-line space adjacent to CP armies (prefer France/Belgium or a RU VP space).
notes: Free level-1 trench and lets both sides entrench. Only one Entrench event per game: once either side plays it, this card is OPS/SR/RP only.

name: Rape of Belgium
play_event_when: CP played Guns of August and AP is still at Mobilization (no Limited War cards added). Play on turn 1 or 2.
notes: -1 VP, +2 WS. Becomes unplayable as an event the moment AP reaches Limited War, so never delay it.

name: British Reinforcements (BR 1)
play_event_when: R-check passes for BR (London AP-controlled, supplied, room for an army). Play in the first AR with no emergency.
notes: Army + corps plus WS +1. One BR reinforcement card per turn.

name: British Reinforcements (BR 4)
play_event_when: R-check passes for BR (London AP-controlled, supplied, room for an army).
notes: Army + corps. Play before the corps-only BR cards.

name: Romania
play_event_when: Romania neutral, Fall of the Tsar unplayed, no neutral entry this turn, and (Tsar Takes Command played, or RU armies border Romania, or CP at TW, AP not).
notes: Raise to 9 once Tsar Takes Command is played: Romania still neutral at Fall of the Tsar gives CP +2 extra VP. Adds Ploesti/Bucharest as CP VP targets. Event-only if CP at TW and AP not (9.5.2.5).

name: Italy
play_event_when: Italy neutral and no neutral entry yet this turn. Play during AP Limited War; at the latest on the turn AP reaches Total War.
notes: +2 WS. If Italy is still neutral after AP reaches TW, CP gains +1 VP every turn. Event-only if CP at TW and AP not (9.5.2.5).

name: Hurricane Barrage
play_event_when: In combat: a BR unit (not AUS/CND/PT/ANA) attacks.
hold_as_cc_when: BR units are adjacent to CP units, especially on a turn with a BR MO.
notes: Not removed; if the attack wins, it can support further BR attacks this turn (once per AR).

name: Air Superiority
play_event_when: In combat: a FR or BR unit (not AUS/CND/PT/ANA) attacks.
hold_as_cc_when: FR or BR units are adjacent to CP units in France/Belgium.
notes: Not removed; reusable within the turn after a won combat.

name: British Reinforcements (AUS, CND)
play_event_when: Turn 2+, no BR reinforcement played this turn, and no BR army reinforcement card in hand that is playable this turn.
notes: Two corps to the Reserve Box; always placeable. AUS/CND do not count as BR for BR combat cards or BR MOs.

name: Phosgene Gas
play_event_when: In combat: a FR unit attacks (prefer a FR MO attack or an attack on an entrenched GE space).
hold_as_cc_when: FR units are adjacent to CP units.
notes: Removed after use.

name: Italian Reinforcements
play_event_when: Italy at war and R-check passes for IT (Rome AP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room).
notes: One army. Unplayable as an event until Italy enters the war.

name: Cloak and Dagger
play_event_when: Whenever you would play this card for OPS, play it as the event instead.
notes: Event = view CP hand + 2 OPS, and the card leaves the deck (thins weak 2-OP cards). Keep it only if you need it later as SR/RP.

name: French Reinforcements (FR 7)
play_event_when: R-check passes for FR (Paris AP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged with room; Orleans only if Paris is full).
notes: One army. One FR reinforcement card per turn.

name: Russian Reinforcements (RU 6, RU 7)
play_event_when: R-check passes for RU with room for TWO armies among Petrograd, Moscow, Kharkov and Caucasus.
notes: Two armies + two corps; the biggest RU card. Play before other RU reinforcements.

name: Lusitania
play_event_when: Blockade has been played and Zimmermann Telegram has not.
notes: -1 VP and +2 WS (helps reach CWS 30 for Zimmermann). Dies once Zimmermann is played, so play it first.

name: Great Retreat
play_event_when: AR 1-2 of a turn, 2+ GE armies adjacent to RU-held spaces with encirclement or OOS risk, and retreating abandons no RU VP space.
notes: Lasts the turn: attacked RU units may step back instead of fighting. +1 WS feeds the Fall of the Tsar threshold. Usually better as 3 OPS.

name: Landships
play_event_when: Whenever you would play it for OPS, play it as the event instead.
notes: Yellow card: the event gives the same 4 OPS and unlocks Royal Tank Corps. Strictly better than OPS use.

name: Yudenitch (RU Reinforcements)
play_event_when: Turkey at war, no RU reinforcement this turn, and a supplied AP-controlled RU space on the Near East map has room.
notes: Caucasus Army vs Turkey. May instead enter at a RU home supply source (9.5.3.4) but then cannot operate in the Near East.

name: Salonika
play_event_when: Bulgaria at war or Serbia threatened; 1+ BR/FR corps in an AP port or Reserve; previous AP action this turn not SR; Salonika usable.
notes: Counts as the AR's SR (no SR in the next AR). +1 WS. After it, MEF can only enter at London. If Greece already joined, Salonika must be AP-controlled with room.

name: MEF (BR Reinforcements)
play_event_when: Turkey at war, no BR reinforcement this turn. Default: place the MEF in London; land at a MEF space only if Salonika unplayed and the target weakly held.
notes: +1 WS. A MEF beachhead army costs 3 OPS to activate; Gallipoli is a poor bot gamble. London placement keeps it as a normal BR army (9.5.3.4).

name: Russian Reinforcements (RU 12)
play_event_when: R-check passes for RU (a RU home supply source with room); no RU reinforcement played this turn.
notes: A full army for a 2-OP card: excellent value.

name: Grand Fleet
play_event_when: Only in the AP action immediately after CP plays High Seas Fleet: cancels its +1 VP.
notes: No other event use. Hold it while High Seas Fleet is unplayed if the hand has other good plays; otherwise a plain 2/2 card.

name: British Reinforcements (BR 3)
play_event_when: R-check passes for BR (London AP-controlled, supplied, room for an army).
notes: Army + two corps.

name: Yanks and Tanks
play_event_when: Whenever you would play it for OPS; top choice when a US unit can attack this AR (+2 to every combat involving US units).
notes: Event gives the same 4 OPS plus the bonus.

name: Mine Attack
play_event_when: In combat: a BR unit attacks an entrenched CP space (once per turn).
hold_as_cc_when: BR units are adjacent to entrenched CP spaces.
notes: Not removed; usable in only one combat per turn.

name: Independent Air Force
play_event_when: Always legal. Play at once if Rathenau is in effect; otherwise play when no higher event is due (pre-empts Rathenau).
notes: Cancels or prevents Rathenau's +1 GE RP every turn for the rest of the game. +1 WS.

name: USA Reinforcements (1 corps)
play_event_when: Over There played; U-Boats Unleashed not in effect (or Convoy played); no US reinforcement this turn; no US army card playable instead.
notes: One corps to the Reserve Box. Not a US army card, so no end-game VP penalty if unplayed.

name: They Shall Not Pass
play_event_when: In combat: CP attacks an undestroyed French fort space (Paris, Verdun, Nancy, Belfort) containing a FR unit; cancels the retreat for losing.
hold_as_cc_when: CP armies are adjacent to an AP-held undestroyed French fort space.
notes: Not removed; stays face up until AP loses a combat with it, then discarded.

name: 14 Points
play_event_when: Zimmermann Telegram has been played.
notes: -1 VP for a 2-OP card. The Peace Terms part is moot in the Historical scenario.

name: Arab Northern Army (BR Reinforcements)
play_event_when: Turkey at war, no BR reinforcement this turn, and no BR army reinforcement card in hand that is playable this turn.
notes: ANA corps placed in Arabia; a nuisance in the Hejaz (holds spaces without converting them).

name: British Reinforcements (BR 5)
play_event_when: R-check passes for BR (London AP-controlled, supplied, room for an army).
notes: Army + BR corps + PT corps.

name: USA Reinforcements (US 1)
play_event_when: Over There played; U-Boats Unleashed not in effect (or Convoy played); no US reinforcement this turn; an AP-controlled unbesieged French port has room.
notes: Each US army card not played as an event by game end gives CP +1 VP (5.7.4.8). Army + two corps.

name: Greece
play_event_when: Greece neutral, no neutral entry yet this turn, and Bulgaria at war or AP units already at Salonika.
notes: +1 WS. Greek units become active; does not block Salonika or MEF.

name: Kerensky Offensive
play_event_when: Fall of the Tsar played and Bolshevik Revolution not. Play instead of OPS, best when a RU unit can attack a space with AH, BU or TU units.
notes: Event gives the same 3 OPS plus +2 for one such RU attack (announce before CP combat cards). Window closes at Bolshevik Revolution.

name: Brusilov Offensive
play_event_when: Play instead of OPS when RU units will attack this AR, best against AH-only entrenched spaces.
notes: Event = 4 OPS, +1 to all RU attacks this AR, trench negation for one attack vs non-GE. +2 WS: avoid if Tsar Takes Command played and CWS + RU VP would reach 33.

name: USA Reinforcements (US 2)
play_event_when: Over There played; U-Boats Unleashed not in effect (or Convoy played); no US reinforcement this turn; an AP-controlled unbesieged French port has room.
notes: Each US army card not played as an event by game end gives CP +1 VP (5.7.4.8). Army + corps.

name: Royal Tank Corps
play_event_when: In combat (Landships played): a BR unit attacks an entrenched clear-terrain space in France, Belgium or Germany (once per turn).
hold_as_cc_when: Landships played and BR units face entrenched clear-terrain CP spaces in the west.
notes: Not removed. Cancels the trench column shift only (not flank or retreat effects). No CC use before Landships.

name: Sinai Pipeline
play_event_when: Turkey at war and either Allenby is in hand (play Pipeline first) or BR units will attack across the Sinai.
notes: Removes the -3 Sinai drm for Allied units and lets Allenby enter at Alexandria.

name: Allenby (BR Reinforcements)
play_event_when: No BR reinforcement this turn. With Sinai Pipeline played, place in Alexandria (AP-controlled, room); otherwise place in London as a normal army.
notes: +1 WS. London placement is always allowed (9.5.3.4) but the army then cannot operate in the Near East.

name: Everyone Into Battle
play_event_when: Legal (Michael, Blucher or Peace Offensive played), AR 1-3, and 2+ mixed-nationality AP stacks in France/Belgium/Italy will attack this turn.
notes: No OPS with the event: it only makes each such stack cost 1 OP for the rest of the turn. +1 WS.

name: Convoy
play_event_when: U-Boats Unleashed has been played.
notes: -1 VP and cancels U-Boats (restores BR RP and US reinforcements).

name: Army of the Orient (FR Reinforcements)
play_event_when: No FR reinforcement this turn and Salonika AP-controlled with room (preferred) or Paris has room.
notes: 5-OP card: if a big OPS turn is needed, OPS may be worth more. In Paris the army cannot go to Salonika later.

name: Zimmermann Telegram
play_event_when: CWS is 30 or more (US Entry marker in Zimmermann Allowed box). Play immediately; the event also gives 5 OPS.
notes: -1 VP, +2 WS, starts US entry, ends Lusitania. Warning: +2 CWS may unlock Fall of the Tsar if Tsar Takes Command is played.

name: Over There
play_event_when: Zimmermann Telegram was played on an earlier turn. Play immediately; the event also gives 5 OPS.
notes: US enters fully: US reinforcements allowed and every AP RP card adds 1 US RP.

name: Guns of August
play_event_when: Mandatory: CP turn 1, action round 1 (Historical rule 5.7.4.3). Legal at no other time.
notes: +2 WS. Destroys Liege, puts GE 1st/2nd Armies there and activates GE 1st/2nd/3rd for combat. Enables AP Rape of Belgium.

name: Wireless Intercepts
play_event_when: In combat, flank step: GE units attack a space holding only RU units from 2+ spaces with an army, defender not in trench/swamp/mountain; flank succeeds automatically.
hold_as_cc_when: GE armies are adjacent to RU units in open (non-trench) terrain.
notes: Removed after use. Engine only checks that the target space contains RU units; follow the card text (only RU units).

name: Von Francois
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks a space containing RU units.
hold_as_cc_when: GE units are adjacent to RU units.
notes: Not removed; reusable within the turn after a won combat.

name: Severe Weather
play_event_when: In combat: AP attacks a CP-defended mountain space in Fall/Winter, or a swamp space in Spring/Fall (+2 to defender).
hold_as_cc_when: This turn or next is Fall/Winter and CP holds mountain spaces facing AP, or Spring/Fall and CP holds swamp spaces facing AP.
notes: Not removed. Fall = turns 3,7,11,15,19; Winter = 4,8,12,16,20; Spring = 5,9,13,17.

name: Landwehr
play_event_when: Berlin CP-controlled and supplied, and reduced GE units worth 2+ RP (army 1, corps 1/2) are supplied or in the Reserve Box.
notes: Two free GE RP to flip reduced units (not rebuild eliminated ones): better than the card's 1 GE RP. Otherwise use as OPS.

name: Entrench
play_event_when: Turn 2+; no Entrench event played yet by either side; a supplied CP army is in a front-line space adjacent to 2+ enemy armies (prefer a VP space).
notes: Free level-1 trench and lets both sides entrench. Only one Entrench event per game.

name: German Reinforcements (GE 9)
play_event_when: R-check passes for GE (Berlin, Essen or Breslau CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: One army. One GE reinforcement card per turn: play multi-army GE cards first.

name: Race to the Sea
play_event_when: CP WS below 4 and a GE unit could end its move in Ostend, Calais or Amiens this turn; otherwise event only to cull the deck.
notes: Restriction lifts automatically at CP WS 4, so the event is usually moot after turn 2.

name: Reichstag Truce
play_event_when: CP not yet at Total War. Play early (turn 1-2 ideal).
notes: +1 VP and +1 WS toward Limited War (Turkey enters at CP LW). Dies when CP reaches TW.

name: SUD Army
play_event_when: An AH unit is (or will be) stacked with GE corps on an active front and the action can be spared.
notes: Permanent: one AH unit + up to 2 GE corps activate for 1 OP, chosen each AR. Moltke overrides it in BE/FR.

name: Oberost
play_event_when: Always legal. Play soon while CP WS is below 4 and GE units face RU fort spaces; later still worth it for +1 WS.
notes: Lets GE units attack RU fort spaces before CP WS 4. +1 WS toward LW/TW on a 2-OP card.

name: German Reinforcements (GE 10)
play_event_when: R-check passes for GE (Berlin, Essen or Breslau CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: Army + two corps.

name: Falkenhayn
play_event_when: Turn 3+, or Moltke has been played (then priority 9: play at once).
notes: +2 WS toward LW/TW; cancels Moltke; prerequisite for Place of Execution.

name: Austria-Hungary Reinforcements (AH 7)
play_event_when: R-check passes for AH (Vienna or Budapest CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: Army + two corps.

name: Chlorine Gas
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks a key target (VP space, an army, entrenched space, or a GE MO attack).
hold_as_cc_when: GE units are adjacent to AP units.
notes: Removed after use.

name: Liman Von Sanders
play_event_when: In combat: a TU unit (not SN) attacks or defends.
hold_as_cc_when: Turkey at war and TU units are adjacent to AP units.
notes: Removed after use.

name: Mata Hari
play_event_when: Whenever you would play this card for OPS, play it as the event instead.
notes: Event = view AP hand + 2 OPS, and the card leaves the deck.

name: Fortified Machine Guns
play_event_when: In combat: AP attacks an entrenched space defended by GE units.
hold_as_cc_when: GE units sit in trenches adjacent to AP units.
notes: Not removed; reusable within the turn after a won defense.

name: Flamethrowers
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks a key target (VP space, an army, entrenched space, or a GE MO attack).
hold_as_cc_when: GE units are adjacent to AP units.
notes: Removed after use.

name: Austria-Hungary Reinforcements (AH 10)
play_event_when: R-check passes for AH (Vienna or Budapest CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: One army.

name: German Reinforcements (GE 11)
play_event_when: R-check passes for GE (Berlin, Essen or Breslau CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: Army + corps. 11th Army pairs with the 11th Army event.

name: German Reinforcements (GE 12)
play_event_when: R-check passes for GE (Berlin, Essen or Breslau CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: Army + corps.

name: Austria-Hungary Reinforcements (AH 11)
play_event_when: R-check passes for AH (Vienna or Budapest CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: One army.

name: Libyan Revolt (TU Reinforcements)
play_event_when: Turkey at war, no Allied units in Libya, and no TU reinforcement this turn.
notes: SN corps in Libya threatens Egypt and diverts BR units; spaces it converts are checked for attrition.

name: High Seas Fleet
play_event_when: Always legal. Best when AP cannot answer: AP still at Mobilization (Grand Fleet not in its deck) or Grand Fleet already played.
notes: +1 VP unless AP plays Grand Fleet as its very next action.

name: Place of Execution
play_event_when: In combat (Falkenhayn played, H-L not): GE attack on an undestroyed French fort space (Paris, Verdun, Nancy, Belfort) gets +2. Action event only once all FR forts destroyed.
hold_as_cc_when: Falkenhayn played, H-L not played, and GE armies adjacent to an undestroyed French fort space.
notes: Removed after use, +1 WS. Dead once H-L Take Command is played.

name: Zeppelin Raids
play_event_when: AP's BR RP marker already shows 2+ this turn (raid removes 4 at the Replacement Phase); otherwise only in AR 5-6 for +1 WS.
notes: Hurts only this turn's BR RP; AP will avoid BR RP plays after seeing it, so time it late in the turn.

name: Tsar Takes Command
play_event_when: CP controls 3+ Russian VP spaces (Capitulation marker in Tsar Takes Command Allowed). Play immediately; the event also gives 4 OPS.
notes: +1 WS; first step of Russian collapse. If RU VP drops below 3 before play, the window closes.

name: 11th Army
play_event_when: GE 11th Army is on the map next to CP corps of other nations and the action can be spared; or late in the game to cull the deck.
notes: Permanent: GE 11th Army plus CP corps activate as one stack. Moltke overrides it in BE/FR.

name: Alpenkorps
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks into or out of a mountain space.
hold_as_cc_when: GE units are adjacent to AP units across mountain terrain (Italy, Balkans, Carpathians).
notes: Not removed; reusable within the turn after a won combat.

name: Kemal
play_event_when: In combat: AP attacks a space defended by a TU unit with CF 1+ (not SN); the defender fires on the Army table (once per turn).
hold_as_cc_when: Turkey at war and AP units are adjacent to TU-defended spaces.
notes: Not removed; usable in only one combat per turn.

name: War in Africa
play_event_when: Always legal. Play early in CP Limited War.
notes: +1 WS; AP must permanently remove a BR corps (not ANA/AUS/CND/BEF/PT) or give CP +1 VP.

name: Walter Rathenau
play_event_when: Independent Air Force not played: play as soon as possible. If IAF already played, only for +2 WS (treat as priority 3).
notes: +1 GE RP every turn for the rest of the game; the earlier, the more RP. +2 WS.

name: Bulgaria
play_event_when: Bulgaria neutral and no neutral entry yet this turn; best early in a turn while Serbia is still fighting.
notes: +2 WS. Bulgarian corps crush Serbia; playing it also blocks AP's Italy/Romania/Greece entry that turn.

name: Mustard Gas
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks a key target (VP space, an army, entrenched space).
hold_as_cc_when: GE units are adjacent to AP units.
notes: Removed after use.

name: U-Boats Unleashed
play_event_when: H-L Take Command played; best once Zimmermann or Over There is played (blocks US reinforcements until Convoy).
notes: -1 BR RP each turn; +2 WS speeds US entry and armistice. AP's Convoy cancels it for -1 VP.

name: Hoffmann
play_event_when: H-L Take Command played and the action can be spared.
notes: +1 to all future CP MO rolls (fewer forced attacks) and +1 WS on a 2-OP card.

name: German Reinforcements (2 corps)
play_event_when: Turn 2+, no GE reinforcement this turn, and no GE army reinforcement card in hand that is playable this turn.
notes: Two corps to the Reserve Box; always placeable.

name: German Reinforcements (2 corps)
play_event_when: Turn 2+, no GE reinforcement this turn, and no GE army reinforcement card in hand that is playable this turn.
notes: Two corps to the Reserve Box; always placeable.

name: Air Superiority
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks.
hold_as_cc_when: GE units are adjacent to AP units.
notes: Not removed; reusable within the turn after a won combat.

name: German Reinforcements (GE 14)
play_event_when: R-check passes for GE (Berlin, Essen or Breslau CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room for an army).
notes: One army.

name: Turkish Reinforcements (YLD)
play_event_when: Turkey at war; R-check passes for TU (Constantinople CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room).
notes: YLD army.

name: Von Below
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks a space holding only IT units, best when it is entrenched (cancels all trench effects).
hold_as_cc_when: Italy at war and GE units are adjacent to IT-only spaces.
notes: Removed after use.

name: Von Hutier
play_event_when: In combat: a GE unit attacks a space containing RU units (attacker fires first, trench effects cancelled).
hold_as_cc_when: GE units are adjacent to RU-held spaces, especially entrenched or VP spaces.
notes: Removed after use. Useless after Brest-Litovsk (no attacks on RU units).

name: Treaty of Brest Litovsk
play_event_when: Bolshevik Revolution played. Play at once unless GE/AH must still attack RU units to take specific Russian VP spaces.
notes: +1 WS. CP victory level drops from 13 to 11; RU cannot attack and only TU may attack RU (Near East).

name: German Reinforcements (GE 17, GE 18)
play_event_when: R-check passes for GE with room for TWO armies among Berlin, Essen and Breslau.
notes: Two armies; play before other GE reinforcements.

name: French Mutiny
play_event_when: Always legal; raise to 8 if this turn's AP MO is France and not yet satisfied.
notes: +1 WS. French MOs become Mutiny turns: FR attacks in FR/BE/GE without US units give CP +1 VP.

name: Turkish Reinforcements (AoI)
play_event_when: Turkey at war; R-check passes for TU (Constantinople CP-controlled, supplied, unbesieged, room).
notes: Army of Islam.

name: Michael
play_event_when: In combat (H-L played): a major GE attack (2+ GE armies) on an entrenched or VP space; cancels trench effects and adds +1.
hold_as_cc_when: H-L played and GE armies face entrenched AP spaces.
notes: Removed after use; +1 WS. Unlocks AP Everyone Into Battle and cancels Lloyd George.

name: Blucher
play_event_when: In combat (H-L played): a GE attack on an entrenched space; cancels trench effects.
hold_as_cc_when: H-L played and GE armies face entrenched AP spaces.
notes: Removed after use. Unlocks AP Everyone Into Battle.

name: Peace Offensive
play_event_when: In combat (H-L played): a GE attack on an entrenched space that the attacker is very likely to clear and advance into.
hold_as_cc_when: H-L played and GE armies face entrenched AP spaces held by few units.
notes: Removed after use. If the attacker does not advance into the space, -1 VP. Unlocks AP Everyone Into Battle.

name: Fall of the Tsar
play_event_when: Tsar Takes Command played and CWS + RU VP is 33+ (marker in Fall of the Tsar Allowed). Play immediately; the event also gives 5 OPS.
notes: +1 VP (+3 if Romania still neutral); RU combat activation costs rise. If never played, -2 VP at game end (5.7.4.9).

name: Bolshevik Revolution
play_event_when: A turn after Fall of the Tsar, and RU VP exceeds the Tsar Fell marker or CP holds all 7 Russian VP spaces. Play at once; event also gives 5 OPS.
notes: Max 1 RU RP per turn; RU MOs end. Unlocks Brest-Litovsk and closes AP's Kerensky window.

name: H-L Take Command
play_event_when: CP at Total War: play early. Delay only while Place of Execution is in hand and a French-fort attack is planned this turn.
notes: +2 WS; unlocks Michael, Blucher, Peace Offensive, Hoffmann, U-Boats; current and future GE MOs become None; kills Place of Execution.

name: Lloyd George
play_event_when: This turn's AP MO is BR and unmet, the GE units facing BR are in level-2 trenches, and no Michael/Blucher/Peace Offensive played.
notes: Can make the BR MO impossible (+1 VP to CP). Otherwise use for 4 OPS.
